target: true-negative: a well-formed marker must still produce a real duration, or the octal fix has simply disabled timing
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability/state; printf '%s x\n' "$(( $(date +%s) * 1000 - 1500 ))" > .agentic/observability/state/agent-y.start; printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name":"SubagentStop","agent_type":"loop-reviewer","agent_id":"y","session_id":"s","last_assistant_message":"{}"}' | AGENTIC_OBSERVE=1 bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" hook SubagentStop >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -c 'select(.event=="agent_stop") | {d: (.duration_ms != null)}' .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
